Title: One Click Integration with Stream Analytics from Event Hubs

Body.Content: With just 1 click, Event Hubs customers can easily visualize incoming streaming data and start writing Stream Analytics query from the Event Hubs portal. Once the query is ready, they will be able to operationalize it in few clicks and start deriving real time insights. Learn more by reviewing the feature overview documentation.
